ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) central mass versus 35% high-intensity (white/grey) distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central medial region is a contiguous low-intensity black mass. Distal tips show high-intensity white patches. Left lobe distal region contains several distinct, low-intensity circular focal spots within the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex approximately 50-60 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes. Most pronounced jaggedness observed at the distal ends; smoother but still irregular towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the peduncle moving into a distinct upward convex curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of textured, high-contrast pixels (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, near-vertical high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the low-intensity black surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at lobe terminals; irregular nicks and small notches along the trailing edge trailing boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Three prominent, dark circular pigment spots arranged in a triangular pattern on the white ventral surface of the left lobe tip.
